packageRules.description: Remove word `dependency` from commit messages and PR titles
Fetch changelog details for twemoji packages

Hold got on the v11 line. The override only exists to satisfy security scanners for dev tooling (@electron/get via electron-builder, react-devtools), which was built against the non-ESM v11 API. v11.8.5+ already includes the security fix, and v12+ is ESM-only.

Hold electron below 43.3.0. The Chromium StatusNotifierItem multiplexer that arrived in 43.3.0 (electron#52416) collapses every tray icon onto a single /StatusNotifierItem object path, so desktops that address the item by its unique D-Bus name instead of its well-known name can no longer resolve the icon and render nothing. Gitify is a tray-first app, so this makes it unusable on those desktops. electron-menubar's visual tray matrix reproduces it on Budgie, Sway/Waybar and LXQt while KDE Plasma stays unaffected. 43.4.1 does NOT fix it despite its release note claiming a Linux tray fix; that change (electron#52952) is described upstream as a bad fix and coincided with LXQt breaking too. Remove this hold only once electron#52674 is closed AND electron-menubar's visual matrix is green on the candidate version.

Group vite-plus with vitest and @vitest/** so they land in a single PR. Grouping alone does not keep them compatible (a group still bumps whichever member has an update); the pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides pinning the vitest family enforce a single copy at runtime, and the hold below stops renovate from proposing versions vite-plus does not bundle yet.

Hold vitest and @vitest/* below 4.1.11. vite-plus 0.2.9 bundles exactly these versions and vp test runs through that bundled copy; anything newer splits the copies inside the test workers and every expect(...).rejects/.resolves.toThrow() fails with 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'indexOf')'. The matching pnpm overrides in pnpm-workspace.yaml are the runtime backstop. To lift this hold: read the vitest/@vitest/* versions pinned in the target vite-plus release's package.json, then raise this cap and the override pins in the same commit so the grouped PR moves everything in lockstep.

Group the playwright package with the Playwright container image that the visual regression job runs in. The image ships the browser build that exact release expects, so a mismatch fails to launch Chromium and would strand the committed screenshot baselines.

Give updates to core runtime dependencies (Electron shell, tray integration, UI primitives, GitHub API client) a distinct commit scope so release-please can surface them in the changelog instead of hiding them with routine dependency bumps

Keep all @octokit packages in a single PR. They share @octokit/openapi-types, and a partial bump resolves two copies of it at once, so the `id: number | bigint` widening lands in only half the types and typechecking fails. `:separateMultipleMajorReleases` otherwise splits the group into one branch per target major.
electron-menubar is a first-party dependency, so skip the minimum release age gate and weekly schedule applied to other packages
